concurrency: Pure value construction; no shared mutable state.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-004, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-04/ARGUS2-ARCH-03 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Retain both source and observation clock domains and their values with a caller-declared unit/representation per value.
Distinguish ingestion order from temporal and causal order; never read an ambient wall clock, infer a unit, or generate a random identity.
Perform no cross-clock-domain comparison, subtraction, sorting or conversion.
Keep an unknown clock mapping, a missing predecessor and an unobserved interval explicit rather than repaired.
Reject a clock value without an explicit domain/unit or a record requiring an undeclared clock mapping.
state_ownership: Owns no durable state; clock values are immutable normalized values carried with their records.
title: ARGUS2-SR-004-CMP allocation - Explicit source and observation clock domains
